## Criterion 1 — failures are replayable from recorded inputs

The recorded input bundle (`replay.rs`) and the minimizer (`reduce.rs`) exist as
tracked code; the CLI wires 3/3 commands (`bundle`, `replay`,
`reduce`); the suites carry 15 replay and 6 reduction arms,
run by the commit gate on every commit.

**Status: met.**

## Criterion 2 — model limitations are distinguishable from target traps

`outcome.rs` defines 4/4 outcome families as separate types
(`TargetEvent`, `Advance`, `ModelError`, `UndefinedCase` — nothing converts between
them, `SEM-01`). The SEM-02 arm (`illegal_instruction_substituted_for_a_limitation_
is_detected`) is present: a limitation dressed as
an illegal-instruction trap is caught by name.

**Status: met.**

## Criterion 3 — malformed evidence links are rejected

The graph and report checker (`graph.rs`, 16 suites) enforces the

The mutation suite carries **11 designated arms** (the eight EVD-09

## Criterion 5 — the performance baseline is measured on a named host

Host: **Apple M4 Pro**; Darwin 27.0.0; built by `rustc 1.95.0 (59807616e 2026-04-14)`. Config: iterations=10000,
warmup=2, reps=12. Re-derive: `cargo run --release -p semulith-cli -- bench`. Median ns/step (the full record, including
min/max and bytes/step, is `baseline.sexp`):

| Mix | Untraced | Instrumented | Instr. (dyn) | Diagnostic | Allocs/step | Spread |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| arithmetic | 52.1 | 69.6 | 69.6 | 73.4 | 1.00 → 1.19 | 1.7–3.6% |
| control | 47.2 | 65.4 | 65.5 | 70.1 | 1.00 → 1.42 | 4.6–113.4% |
| memory | 54.1 | 71.0 | 70.9 | 76.9 | 1.00 → 1.23 | 3.9–6.5% |
| fault | 50.9 | 69.4 | 67.5 | 71.0 | 1.00 → 1.20 | 4.5–7.4% |

Static vs dynamic observer dispatch: ×0.974–×1.002 across the mixes — within the
measured noise. The record states `(thresholds none)`; the spread above is what a
future threshold must be set from (RUST-04).

**Status: met.**

## Criterion 6 — a compiled freestanding guest retires under first-divergence comparison

`guests/` holds **4 assembly guests** and **0 C guests**.
The four tracked guests ARE freestanding programs — assembled by the tracked assembler
from `.s` sources — and they retire under first-divergence comparison against TWO
pinned references (sail-riscv and spike, 34/34 aligned steps; re-run:
`scripts/run_semulith_smoke.py`). But the roadmap's clause names a **compiled** guest
with **C as the first guest path**, and no C-toolchain guest exists in this tree.

**Status: NOT met as written.** The assembled-guest differential is real and recorded;
the C path is the gap. Owner: `P2-SCALAR.5` (external and directed campaigns).

## Limitations (`EVD-08`)

1. **The verdict is `incomplete`, and criterion 6 is why.** A gate report exists to say
   exactly this, exactly here.
2. **Criteria 1–5 are evidenced by the presence and shape of tracked machinery**, whose
   every claim is exercised by the commit gate (`make check`) — this report re-derives
   counts and names from the sources, it does not re-run the suites. The un-fakeable
   leg is the gate itself.
3. **The baseline is one host's measurement session**, frozen as data with its noise;
   it is not a portable constant and sets no threshold.
4. **Finite differential testing is not proof** (EVD-01): the guests, suites and
   differentials are tested evidence for the cases they exercise.
